about: Cases for N7, a worker's follow-ups (design.md §8). Each case is one follow-up reported by the finder task in a job; expect is what should happen: task (a new task), planned (another task already covers it), user (only the user can decide), later (out of scope). priority is the expected urgency of a task, where one stands out. npm run bench-n7 scores the decision model and the file rule on them.

blog.goal: Add a slugify(title) function in src/slug.js that turns a blog title into a URL slug: lowercase, words joined by single dashes, punctuation dropped, German umlauts transliterated. Add tests in test/slug.test.js and list the function in the README.
acceptance: slugify passes the behaviour checks, umlauts included
test/slug.test.js exists and npm test passes

helpers.goal: Add readingTime(text) in src/reading.js and excerpt(text, n) in src/excerpt.js, each with tests. Both must handle empty text and German text.
acceptance: readingTime returns minutes at 200 wpm, at least 1
excerpt returns the first n words with an ellipsis when cut
